data.body: Gerrit 3515 PS1 Verified -1 (run 44932827832): the only failing job, pytest (macos-latest, py3.13), never ran a test. uv could not build the package because fetching https://pypi.org/simple/editables/ timed out after 3 retries ('client error (Connect) ... operation timed out'). That is environmental. Separately, Windows validation 44926475373 (job 136913563376) left 1 of the 13 class tests failing: test_snapshot_gc_trigger::test_the_detached_child_is_anchored_to_the_durable_store_root asserted the POSIX-only start_new_session kwarg. It now asserts the platform's own _proc._detach_kwargs(). The other 2 failures are test_git_metrics (cloth-osmophilic-izuthrush). The new patch set db17fef97f4 also addresses 2 review advisories: docs/concurrency.md qualifies the SIGTERM forward for Windows, and the off-POSIX guard test now uses a foreign-pid stamp (it fails with the guard removed). Windows re-validation: run 44990533141. Not using recheck, since a new patch set is needed anyway.
